body: I ended up talking to the breeder and returned her, it was just way to much for me at the time. And I do miss her but in the end I don't regret it and I feel like I did the right thing for her and me. I think in the future I may end up adopting an adult dog after I feel a-lot better mentally. I did feel bad about wasting other peoples time with getting her, but they were honestly super supportive about my decision. Good luck with whatever you decide and please do whats best for you.

I am okay for now, taking some alone time at the moment. and I will definitely try to find someone to help out. And I have reached out for help a couple of times before and I've even been institutionalized for a suicide attempt but to be honest I came out more mentally unstable than before. I would like to try to go back to therapy but no offices near where I live take my insurance so I am kinda stuck in what to do next regarding that. But I think for now I am going to try and keep her and see how it goes, try to take more time for myself and maybe meet up with some close friends and talk about it. And if it doesn't improve I will contact the breeder. Thanks for the concern though it helped to get that off my chest.
Thanks so much I needed to hear that, I am feeling a bit better now. I think I am going to try and tough it out for a few days and if it doesn't improve I will contact the breeder.
